The week 18 game results are now up.

The weekly lineup and trade deadline is each Monday before the first MLB game begins. Week 19 lineups and trades have an early deadline of 2:35 PM Eastern/11:35 AM Pacific time on Monday, July 27th.

The first MLB game for week 18 was Monday, July 20th
6:40 PM Eastern/3:40 PM Pacific time. That means your week 18 lineup card
needed to be submitted by/before the start of the first MLB game on Monday the 20th
to be used for the week 18 Scoresheet games.

There is a page on our web site that lists any new positions that players
have qualified at so far in 2026. That page is at:
Players new positions

On this league web page there is a link to a program called Score-It, which gives
a play by play description of games in a text format. Also shown is a running
boxscore and a little diagram showing men on base, the score, number of outs, etc.
To use Score-it, the first line under "See also:" reads "Play games for " followed
by underlined links named "Team 1", "Team 2", etc. Just click on the link to the
team's games you want to see and away you go.

The 2026 online order form is available, and can be used to order and pay for teams.
That form is at:
Scoresheet Baseball Order Form

There are still some orphaned teams available in existing continuing leagues,
and with the season now beginning, the 2026 team fee for
orphaned teams in our keeper leagues is now just $29.
To see rosters of those available teams please visit the following link:
View Available Teams
For private league postings please go to our message board at:
Scoresheet message boards

For leagues that follow our normal in-season draft schedule, here is the
schedule for our five mid-season drafts to be held in 2026:
April 2026 draft, April 15-17, rounds 36, 37 and 38
May 2026 draft, May 13-15, rounds 39, 40 and 41
June 2026 draft, June 17-19, rounds 42, 43 and 44
July 2026 draft, July 22-24, rounds 45 and 46 (round 45 will be the first round
where the 2026 MLB amateur draftees will be eligible)
August 2026 draft, August 26-28, rounds 47 and 48

NOTE: The rounds given above are for leagues that drafted
the normal 35 rounds in the pre-season. If your league drafted
a different number of rounds then you need to adjust the
round numbers accordingly if you are reporting any traded picks.
Also, the draft order for the first round of each draft will go in the reverse
order of the standings *at the time of the draft*. The April and May drafts
will snake, and in the June, July and August drafts, all rounds will be in reverse
order of the standings at the time of the draft.
